turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's essay. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
Can I ask something off the record?
We're not going off the record. Owen's zero.
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned. Who decided on the zero?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
Are you calling me a liar, or a bad mother? Owen has never cheated. Say what you have, or I'm going to the principal.
